v7optimize.tip.botJson: Full bot strategy JSON for this side. neutralized/review markers flag values that differ from runtime defaults and deserve a check.
v7optimize.tip.boundsFixed: When checked, the parameter is pinned at its current value and stored in optimize.fixed_params.
v7optimize.tip.boundsParam: Parameter being optimized, using the bot path (e.g. long.total_wallet_exposure_limit).
v7optimize.tip.boundsRange: Search range: the minimum and maximum values the optimizer may assign.
v7optimize.tip.boundsStep: Discrete step the optimizer uses inside the range. Leave empty to fall back to the built-in precision.
v7optimize.tip.btc_collateral_cap: Target (and ceiling) share of account equity held as BTC collateral. 0 keeps the account fully in USD, 1.0 mirrors the legacy 100% BTC mode, values above 1 allow leveraged BTC collateral.
v7optimize.tip.btc_collateral_ltv_cap: Loan-to-value ceiling (USD debt / equity) enforced when topping up BTC. 0 or null allows unlimited debt; e.g. 0.6 stops buying BTC once leverage exceeds that threshold.
v7optimize.tip.candle_interval_minutes: Aggregates 1-minute candles into larger intervals for backtests. Use 1 for full resolution.
v7optimize.tip.coinOverrideConfigs: Per-coin bot parameter overrides as JSON, keyed by symbol.
v7optimize.tip.coin_sources: Per-exchange coin source overrides as JSON. Controls where each exchange's coin universe is loaded from.
v7optimize.tip.compress_results_file: Compress the optimize results file to save disk space.
v7optimize.tip.configName: Name of this optimize config. Saved as opt_v7/[name].json in the PBGui data directory (opt_v8 for PB8).
v7optimize.tip.deap.crossover_eta: Crowding factor (eta) for simulated-binary crossover. Lower values let offspring move farther from their parents.
v7optimize.tip.deap.crossover_probabilit: Probability of crossing two individuals. crossover + mutation probability together stay at or below 1.0.
v7optimize.tip.deap.mutation_eta: Crowding factor (eta) for polynomial mutation. Lower values produce heavier-tailed, more aggressive steps.
v7optimize.tip.deap.mutation_indpb: Probability that each parameter mutates once mutation triggers. 0 auto-scales to 1 / number_of_parameters.
v7optimize.tip.deap.mutation_probability: Probability of mutating an individual to maintain diversity.
v7optimize.tip.deap.offspring_multiplier: Multiplier on population_size for how many offspring are produced per generation. Values above 1.0 increase exploration.
v7optimize.tip.deap.population_size: Size of the DEAP parent population per generation.
v7optimize.tip.enable_overrides: Per-parameter enable overrides the optimizer may flip while searching, as JSON. Entries the current strategy cannot apply are dropped on load.
v7optimize.tip.end_date: Last candle of the backtest window. 'Now' fills in today's date.
v7optimize.tip.exchanges: Exchanges included in this optimize run. At least one exchange is required.
v7optimize.tip.fine_tune_params: Comma-separated bot parameter groups re-tuned on top of the seed config (PB8 fine-tune phase).
v7optimize.tip.fixed_params: Parameters excluded from optimization, held at their current value.
v7optimize.tip.gpu.auto_lean_parallelism: Let the GPU backend size parallelism automatically for this host.
v7optimize.tip.gpu.batch_size: Evaluations batched per GPU dispatch. Leave empty for automatic sizing.
v7optimize.tip.gpu.drift_halt: Halt the run when measured GPU drift exceeds this value. Leave empty to disable the guard.
v7optimize.tip.gpu.drift_min_samples: Minimum drift samples required before accuracy is judged.
v7optimize.tip.gpu.drift_probes: Probe evaluations comparing GPU results against exact evaluation.
v7optimize.tip.gpu.drift_window: Rolling window size used to measure GPU drift.
v7optimize.tip.gpu.exact_workers: CPU workers validating GPU results exactly in the background.
v7optimize.tip.gpu.halving.enabled: Enable successive halving: repeatedly keep only the best fraction of candidates.
v7optimize.tip.gpu.halving.history_fract: Comma-separated fractions of history used per halving rung (e.g. 0.1, 0.3, 1).
v7optimize.tip.gpu.halving.min_survivors: Minimum survivors kept per rung regardless of the fraction.
v7optimize.tip.gpu.halving.survival_frac: Fraction of candidates surviving each halving rung.
v7optimize.tip.gpu.max_dispatch_candidat: Upper bound of candidate bars considered per GPU dispatch. Leave empty for automatic.
v7optimize.tip.gpu.max_pending_exact: Maximum exact validations queued before dispatching slows down.
v7optimize.tip.gpu.population_size: GPU population size. Leave empty for automatic sizing.
v7optimize.tip.gpu.validate_per_generati: How many candidates are exactly validated each generation.
v7optimize.tip.hsl_enabled: Master switch for the hard-stop-loss (HSL) logic on this side. Other hsl_* params are ignored while disabled.
v7optimize.tip.hsl_signal_mode: Account-level hard-stop-loss signal behaviour during evaluation: pside keeps long/short signals separate, unified shares one combined signal.
v7optimize.tip.ignored_coins.long: Coins excluded from long positions. Adding a coin here removes it from approved_coins.long.
v7optimize.tip.ignored_coins.short: Coins excluded from short positions. Adding a coin here removes it from approved_coins.short.
v7optimize.tip.iters: Number of backtests (generations) run per optimize session.
v7optimize.tip.limitsJson: Raw optimize.limits JSON: metric thresholds whose violations add penalties to every objective.
v7optimize.tip.limitsSection: Penalize backtests whose metrics cross these thresholds. Penalties push a config off the Pareto front; they do not disqualify it directly.
v7optimize.tip.market_cap: Minimum market capitalization in millions of USD used by the coin filters.
v7optimize.tip.max_pending_starting_eval: How many starting-config evaluations may queue per CPU before the optimizer waits.
v7optimize.tip.memory_snapshot_interval_: Interval between memory snapshot telemetry entries (RSS, cache footprint, task counts). 0 disables.
v7optimize.tip.minimum_coin_age_days: Excludes coins younger than this many days.
v7optimize.tip.n_cpus: Parallel CPU workers inside one optimize run.
v7optimize.tip.n_positions: Maximum number of simultaneous positions for this side. 0 disables long/short.
v7optimize.tip.notices_ignore: Ignore coins that carry a notice warning on CoinMarketCap.
v7optimize.tip.objectiveScenario: Score every config on aggregated suite metrics or on one named scenario (suite aggregate / named scenario).
v7optimize.tip.ohlcv_source_dir: Optional local OHLCV archive for backtests/optimizations: [root]/[exchange]/1m/[symbol]/YYYY-MM-DD.npz. Leave empty to use the default cache/CCXT fetch.
v7optimize.tip.only_cpt: Only trade coins that are allowed for CopyTrading (CPT list).
v7optimize.tip.pareto_max_size: Maximum Pareto-optimal configs kept on disk. Least diverse members are pruned first, per-objective extremes are preserved.
v7optimize.tip.polish_bounds_mode: How polish treats bounds: clamp stays inside current bounds, override-tunable/override-all widen them.
v7optimize.tip.polish_percentage: Share of the budget (0-100%) spent polishing the best candidates inside their bounds.

v7optimize.tip.pymoo.crossover_prob_var: Crossover probability used by the pymoo backend.
v7optimize.tip.pymoo.effectiveAlgorithm: Algorithm resolved from the current selection and objective count.
v7optimize.tip.pymoo.eliminate_duplicate: Drop genetically identical offspring before evaluation to save backtests.
v7optimize.tip.pymoo.json: Raw optimize.pymoo JSON. The structured controls above merge into this on save.
v7optimize.tip.pymoo.mutationProbMode: auto derives the mutation probability as 1 / number_of_parameters; explicit pins it.
v7optimize.tip.pymoo.mutation_eta: Crowding factor (eta) for polynomial mutation. Lower values give heavier-tailed steps.
v7optimize.tip.pymoo.mutation_prob_var: Mutation probability used by the pymoo backend.

v7optimize.tip.pymoo.refPartitions: Partitions per objective axis for NSGA-III reference directions.

v7optimize.tip.runtime.shortHslEnabled: Runtime override enabling hard-stop-loss for the short side at launch time.
